title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during regional failover to prevent cascade load-shedding
author: Ava Martinez
description: Emergency hotfix to prevent the SLO enforcer from thrashing during cross-region failover. Root cause: during regional failover we observed a spike in API latencies which triggered aggressive load-shedding in the SLO enforcer; load-shedding feedback to routing caused additional regional failovers and a cascading reduction in capacity. This PR adds a multi-pronged mitigation: (1) introduce exponential cooldown/backoff for per-region circuit-breaker reopen attempts, (2) require a minimum healthy-instance check before escalating global load-shedding, (3) add a short-lived conservative fallback profile for incoming requests from failing regions to avoid immediate shedding of all request classes, (4) harden transition logic to avoid double-counting error budgets across routing and enforcer, and (5) add targeted unit and e2e tests and metrics so we can validate behavior in future canaries. The change is intentionally conservative and gated behind a feature flag (slo_enforcer:regional_stability_v1) so we can roll forward/back quickly. Includes operational runbook updates and new Grafana alerts that surface rapid reopen/cooldown events and shed-rate spikes.
